data.name: Bhanumati
data.gender_notes: Bhanumati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhanumati is a divine feminine name derived from Sanskrit. It is composed of two words: Bhana (meaning 'to shine') and Mati (meaning 'wisdom'). This name signifies the goddess who bestows both wisdom and prosperity upon her devotees. The name Bhanumati carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhanumati usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhanumati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhanumati total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
